decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template needed little investment and is only mentioned in passing, but it fits the agency and shop focus and costs almost nothing to keep available.
The responsive template is a low-investment add-on with no visible public commitment, so it is easy to drop, but its upkeep cost is minimal and it supports the core hosting offer.
Premium support builds on the firm's announced strategy of round-the-clock expert support, so dropping it would contradict that public positioning.
The version management tool reflects in-house development investment, has its own page, and fits the stated aim of tools that reduce recurring operational work.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer, but it was launched as a visible product line with its own page and several models, and its GDPR relevance lets weak demand be read as temporary.
